name: Darklight
body:
School evocation [darkness]; Level antipaladin 3, bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

This spell functions as the spell darkness except that you and one ally per level can see through the area of darkness as if it were not active.
